CITIZENS’ ADVISORY COMMISSION ON DISABILITIES AGENDA
  THURSDAY, JUNE 12, 2025
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 1:00 PM

Kim Vuong, Chair  Marissa Gonzalez, Member
Stephen Adams, Vice Chair  Randy Hope, Member
Chaka Garbutt, Secretary  Arthur Romo, Member
Julie Dean, Member  Gretchen Swanson, Member

  Citizens' Advisory Commission on Disabilities In-Person Meeting

  Members Of The Public Have The Option To Submit Online Public Comments Or Email
  Comments To Jennifer.Kumiyama@longbeach.gov

  Comments May Also Be Provided In The Zoom Meeting Using The Raise Hand Function

  Please Dial: (213) 338-8477 / Meeting ID: 981 6445 6257
  Passcode: 116311
  https://longbeach-gov.zoom.us/j/98164456257

 Please Note The Zoom Meeting May Encounter Technical Disruptions, But In-Person Access
  And Public Comment Will Continue To Be Available In Accordance With The Brown Act

  Please View The Meeting From Your Computer, Tablet, Or Smartphone
  Via: https://longbeach.primegov.com/public/portal?fromiframe=true

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-55565  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Citizen’s Advisory Commission on
  Disabilities meeting of Thursday, May 8, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  25-55567  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from State Treasury
  regarding CalABLE, a tax-advantaged savings and investment plan designed
  specifically for individuals with disabilities in California.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  25-55566  Recommendation to receive and file reports from current Ad Hoc Committees;
  discuss anticipated Ad Hoc Committees for upcoming projects; and, if appropriate,
  take action to dissolve or create Ad Hoc Committees.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

Opportunity to address the Citizens' Advisory Commission on Disabilities on non-agenda items.
Each speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Tamela Austin, City Clerk Analyst, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior
to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the Americans
with Disabilities Act, please contact Jennifer Kumiyama at (562) 570-6257
or jennifer.kumiyama@longbeach.gov.

A motion was made by Commissioner Dean, to elect Commissioner Dean for Secretary of
the Citizens’ Advisory Commission on Disabilities. The motion carried by the following vote:

Yes:  8  Dean, Gonzalez, Hope, Romo, Swanson, Garbutt, Adams, Vuong
No:  0  None
Recused:  0  None
Abstain:  0  None
Absent:  0  None

Jennifer Kumiyama, Citywide Accessibility Coordinator, City Manager Department, declared the
nominations open for Chair.

Commissioner Romo nominated Commissioner Swanson for Chair of the Citizens’ Advisory
Commission on Disabilities.

Secretary Garbutt nominated Secretary Garbutt for Chair of the Citizens’ Advisory Commission on
Disabilities.

There being no further nominations, Jennifer Kumiyama, Citywide Accessibility Coordinator, City
Manager Department, declared the nominations closed for Chair.

 Commissioner Swanson accepted the Chair of the Citizens’ Advisory Commission on Disabilities
nomination.

 Secretary Garbutt declined the Chair of the Citizens’ Advisory Commission on Disabilities
nomination.

 Jennifer Kumiyama, Citywide Accessibility Coordinator, City Manager Department, declared the
nominations open for Vice Chair.

Commissioner Gonzalez nominated Secretary Garbutt for Vice Chair of the Citizens’ Advisory
Commission on Disabilities.

There being no further nominations, Jennifer Kumiyama, Citywide Accessibility Coordinator, City
Manager Department, declared the nominations closed for Vice Chair.

 Secretary Garbutt accepted the Vice Chair of the Citizens’ Advisory Commission on Disabilities
nomination.

 Jennifer Kumiyama, Citywide Accessibility Coordinator, City Manager Department, declared the
nominations open for Secretary.
